

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Fire Pig|kanji=丁亥|romaji=hinoto i|onyomi=teigai|p=dīhài|w=ting-hai|mi=tʰiŋ⁵³ xaɪ̯|y=deng1 hoi6|j=deng1 hoi6|ci=tɛŋ hɐi|mc=tæŋ ɣəi|oc-bs=tæŋ ɢəʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Fire Pig''' (丁亥, ''hinoto i''; onyomi ''teigai'') is the 24th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 24th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Dog|ja|丙戌}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Rat|ja|戊子}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|af|Aardtak|als|Erdzweige|az|Türk-monqol təqvimi|ca|Branques terrestres|cdo|Dê-ciĕ|de|Erdzweige|fa|شاخه‌های زمینی|fi|Maalliset oksat|fr|Branche terrestre|gan|地支|hak|Thi-chṳ̂|id|Cabang Bumi|it|Ramo terrestre|ja|十二支|ko|지지 (역법)|mk|Земски гранки|ms|Dizhi|pl|Ziemskie gałęzie|ru|Земные ветви|tr|12 hayvanlı takvim|ug|12 مۆچەل تەقۋىمى|uk|Земні гілки|za|Deihcei|zh|地支|zh_min_nan|Tē-chi|zh_yue|地支|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''亥'' (Pig) is Yin Water; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|af|Wu Xing|ar|نظرية العناصر الخمسة|bcl|Wu Xing|ca|Cinc processos (Wuxing)|cdo|Ngū-hèng|cs|Pět prvků|da|De fem faser|de|Fünf-Elemente-Lehre|el|Ου Σιν|eo|Skolo de la kvin elementoj|es|Wu Xing|et|Viie elemendi õpetus|fa|وو شینگ|fi|Viisi elementtiä|fr|Wuxing (cosmologie)|gan|五行|hak|Ńg-hàng|he|חמשת היסודות|hu|Öt elem (kínai)|hy|Ու Սին|id|Wu Xing|it|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想|ko|오행|lt|Using|mk|Пет елементи|ms|Wu Xing|nl|Wu Xing|no|De fem elementene|oc|Cinc elements (Wuxing)|pl|Wu xing|pt|Wu Xing|ro|Wu Xing|ru|У-син|simple|Five elements|sk|Učenie o piatich živloch|sl|Pet elementov (vušing)|sq|Wuxing (filozofia kineze)|sr|Пет космичких усмерења|sv|De fem elementen (wu xing)|tl|Limang elemento|tr|Beş element|uk|У-сін|vi|Ngũ hành|wuu|五行|za|Nguxhengz|zh|五行|zh_classical|陰陽五行|zh_min_nan|Ngó͘-hêng|zh_yue|五行|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

=== Events ===
* In {{ill|Empress Jitō|en|Empress Jitō|qid=Q232026|lt=Jitō Tennō}}'s 1st year (687 AD), from the Asukaike Kōbō Ruins, {{ill|Fuhonsen|en|Fuhonsen|qid=Q11456988|lt=Tomihon-sen}} were detected and wooden tablets inscribed with "丁亥年" were unearthed from the same soil layer, leading to the estimation that the Tomihon-sen were cast during this period.
* In {{ill|Ōei|en|Ōei|qid=Q1193078|lt=Ōei}} 14 (January 1408 AD), the {{ill|1408 Ōei earthquake|ja|応永地震|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōei Earthquake|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q105715627}} occurred; it may have been confused with the Hōei Earthquake, which falls within the same Sexagenary cycle.
* In {{ill|Hōei|en|Hōei|qid=Q1145262|lt=Hōei}} 4 (1707 AD), the "Teigai no Hen" (Crisis of 亥) occurred, marked by the {{ill|1707 Hōei earthquake|en|1707 Hōei earthquake|qid=Q2001581|lt=Hōei Earthquake}}<ref>[https://cir.nii.ac.jp/crid/1390572174727612416 都司嘉宣(1981)] 都司嘉宣編: 高知県地震津波史料, 防災科学技術研究資料 57, i-253, 1981-03-20, 独立行政法人防災科学技術研究所</ref> and the {{ill|Hōei eruption|en|Hōei eruption|qid=Q288045|lt=Hōei Great Eruption}}.
* From January 25 to February 6, 2008, the Teigai Snow Disaster occurred; since this period fell before the Lunisolar New Year (正月) and Spring Festival (春節), it is considered part of a Teigai year.
